name: Asteroids (rev 4)
status: source located, complement not yet read
layout_source: DP-143 drawing package, sheets 01A/01B/02A/02B (4 sheets per revision)
grid: letter+number designators, A2..L12 seen; larger than Pong's A-H x 1-9
findings: Each IC block on the drawing carries both its grid designator and its part number.
Designators are recoverable by OCR (92 found on sheet 2 side A); the hand-lettered part numbers are not (1 of ~40).
The technical manual contains no designator-to-part table, so the parts must be read from the drawings.

Reference designations differ by PCB revision: red designators apply to -05/-06 boards, black to -01 thru -04. The same chip is C10 on one and C11 on the other. Any conversion must state which revision it describes.
estimate: ~100 ICs across 4 sheets, read by eye
